t: Cecil Coleman - Communication Dated March 21, 1940 From H.%C9 Consulate-General

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S B REGISTRY / No. S. B. D. 974 / Special Branch: MAXIM / Date April 18, 1940）

Subject Cecil COLEMAN - Communication dated March 21, 1940 from H.B.M.
Consulate-General.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by D.I. Crawford.

With reference to the attached communication
dated March 21, 1940 from H.B.M. Consulate-General
requesting information in regard to one Cecil COLEMAN,
I have to report that this individual's correct name is:
Cecil Edward KOHLMANN

He is a British subject by birth and is of
German Jewish extraction. He holds British Passport
No. 223620 issued by the Foreign Office, London on
July 10, 1930. It has been renewed and is valid
until July 10, 1940. This document, which has been
seen, bears an endorsement to the effect that "bearer
wishes to be known as Cecil COLEMAN."

In connection with the remarks "We have no record
of Coleman" appearing in the attached letter, it has
to be pointed out that the person under discussion,
under the name of Cecil COLEMAN, was charged in the
British Court on August 29, 1939 for a breach of
bye-law 34 (driving a car without a licence) when he
was convicted and cautioned.

（签名：Jo. Pitts）
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. 1，特别股。
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特别股登记处 / 编号 S. B. D. 974 / 特别股：MAXIM / 日期 1940年4月18日）

事由 塞西尔·科尔曼 (Cecil COLEMAN) - 英国驻上海总领事馆1940年3月21日来函。
由 D.S. 皮茨 (Pitts) 拟写。由 D.I. 克劳福德 (Crawford) 转呈。

关于随附的英国驻上海总领事馆1940年3月21日来函，该函要求提供有关一名叫塞西尔·科尔曼 (Cecil COLEMAN) 的人员的信息，现报告如下：此人的正确姓名为：
塞西尔·爱德华·科尔曼 (Cecil Edward KOHLMANN)

他生来即为英国臣民，具有德裔犹太人血统。他持有英国外交部于1930年7月10日在伦敦签发的第223620号英国护照。该护照已续期，有效期至1940年7月10日。经查验，该证件上有一项批注，内容为“持照人希望以塞西尔·科尔曼 (Cecil COLEMAN) 之名为人所知”。

针对随附信件中出现的“我方无科尔曼 (Coleman) 之记录”这一评语，需指出的是，本案所涉人员曾以塞西尔·科尔曼 (Cecil COLEMAN) 之名，于1939年8月29日在英国法院被控违反第34号附例（无证驾驶汽车），当时被判有罪并受到训诫。

（签名：Jo. Pitts）
副督察 (D. S.)

警司 (特别股) (D. C. (Special Branch))。

British Consulate-General,
Shanghai
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S B REGISTRY
21st March 1940
No. S. B. D. ____
Date ____

Dear Mr. Yorke,

A naturalised British subject has written
to us in connexion with a claim against a certain Cecil
Coleman, Room 262, Hamilton House, 170 Kiangse Road,
whom she described as of German-Jewish descent and holding
a British passport.

We have no record of Coleman and I wonder
whether you can help to discover what Coleman's
nationality is and whether he holds a British passport.

Yours sincerely,

〔此处为手写签名〕

Passport Control Officer.

R. W. Yorke, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

〔此处有手写批注，字迹潦草难以辨认〕

特别股登记处
1940年3月21日
编号 S. B. D. ____
日期 ____

亲爱的约克先生：

一位归化英国臣民致信我方，涉及对某位塞西尔·科尔曼 (Cecil Coleman) 的索赔事宜，此人住址为江西路170号汉密尔顿大厦262室，她描述其为德裔犹太血统并持有英国护照。

我方没有科尔曼 (Coleman) 的记录，不知阁下能否协助查明科尔曼的国籍以及他是否持有英国护照。

此致，

〔此处为手写签名〕

护照管制官。

R. W. 约克 (Yorke) 先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

〔此处有手写批注，字迹潦草难以辨认〕
